verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing is documented to automate recurring payments, create custom pricing plans, and handle trials and renewals. The MCP method list shows subscriptions can be created, updated and cancelled, and a community user reports getting recurring payments running in under an hour. Upgrades are only implied by the subscription-update capability, and proration is never mentioned. missing for 10: explicit documentation of plan upgrades/downgrades, any evidence of proration handling, independent corroboration of trials/upgrades.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set up recurring subscription billing with plans, trials, upgrades, and proration

citations.quote: Use Stripe Billing to manage subscriptions and invoicing. It automates recurring payments, creates custom pricing plans, and handles billing periods, such as trials and renewals.
Accept one-time and subscription payments from more than 125 local payment methods.
I was up and running and accepting recurring payments in less than an hour.
